title: HCR-REASONER: Synergizing Large Language Models and Theory for Human-like Causal Reasoning
reasoning: The paper framework incorporates causal judgment modulators from cognitive science, specifically morality and prescriptive norms. It evaluates LLMs using the HCR-BENCH benchmark, which includes reasoning about whether agents violated moral or social norms to determine causal responsibility, effectively benchmarking human-like moral and ethical judgment.
